name: Anand Kumar
summary:
Full Stack (MERN) Developer with strong frontend expertise in React.js and Angular, experienced in building scalable enterprise
web applications. Skilled in developing reusable components, dynamic forms, and data-driven dashboards with secure API
integrations. Passionate about creating high-performance, user-centric solutions with clean and maintainable code.

responsibilities: Worked on two real-world enterprise applications: a B2B Application Portal (Angular) deployed in production and a Back Office Admin Dashboard (React.js) currently in UAT.

Built a B2B Application Portal using Angular with dynamic Reactive Forms for student applications and developed a Back Office Admin Panel using React.js to manage student applications and internal operations.
Integrated 10+ REST APIs for student listing, program–course data and developed a fully responsive UI ensuring consistent user experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices for both projects.
Collaborated with backend and QA teams in an agile environment to deliver production features.

Built scalable admin dashboards using React.js and PrimeReact, to manage large student datasets with dynamic data tables, server-side pagination, global searching, multi-column sorting, and advanced filtering.
Developed config-driven reusable components and custom hooks to standardize tables, workflows, and UI behavior across multiple modules
Integrated SSO authentication and REST APIs for secure enterprise dashboard access.

Implemented bulk workflows including approval/rejection, session updates, along with Excel-based data uploads, server- side CSV exports, and UTR/PO number update actions to streamline internal operations.
Developed a dynamic multi-step B2B application portal using Angular Reactive Forms and PrimeNG Stepper with complex validations and conditional rendering.
Designed a secure student application flow where form access is controlled through email-based unique application links with student ID validation.
Implemented step-wise API auto-save enabling users to resume applications without data loss.
Built secure document upload with Base64 encoding and PDF/image preview, while improving UX through real- time validation, progress tracking, and dynamic form rendering.
Developed a responsive food delivery web application using React.js, Vite, and Tailwind CSS with a mobile-first UI and optimized user experience.
Implemented menu browsing, category filtering, cart management, and checkout flow using React Router and Context API for global state management.
Built modular and reusable UI components to improve code maintainability and scalability.

Gained hands-on experience in developing full-stack web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js, completed multiple projects.
